Use case: identity-preserve.
Input image 1: identity, clothing, skin texture, scale, camera, lighting and background reference. Replace ONLY the hand pose and the held prop as described. Remove the wooden stamp completely.
Asset: ONE photorealistic square PNG, requested output 2048x2048, for the same realistic hand-cursor web animation asset set.
LOCK IDENTITY: the exact same adult's RIGHT hand, natural light skin, pores, fine dark arm hair, short natural unpolished nails, same rolled-up light-blue cotton shirt sleeve and fabric. Photographic skin, not smooth plastic or illustration. Anatomically correct five digits; natural occlusion is allowed. Back of hand visible, palm oriented down.
LOCK STYLE AND FRAMING: top-down flat lay, orthographic camera exactly perpendicular to the surface, soft diffuse upper-left daylight, neutral white balance, sharp focus throughout. Keep hand and forearm at the same apparent physical scale as reference. Forearm runs diagonally to the LOWER-RIGHT CORNER, sleeve and arm cropped by bottom/right image edges there. Hand occupies upper-left / central area. Large clean negative space. No sheet of paper visible.
BACKGROUND: identical perfectly FLAT solid neutral mid-gray #7f7f7f RGB(127,127,127), including near the hand. No cast shadow or contact shadow, no gradient or vignette. Only subtle intrinsic shading on hand and object. Shadows will be supplied in code. Do not produce a contact sheet or multiple poses.
Avoid: text, letters, words, numbers, watermark, logo, rings, jewelry, nail polish, tattoo, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, deformed hand, two hands, cartoon, illustration, 3D render, perspective camera tilt, depth of field, blur, harsh shadows, cast shadows, colored light, vignette.
POSE: a natural default pointing / hovering computer-cursor hand. The index finger is gently EXTENDED away from the other digits and clearly emphasized, pointing diagonally toward the UPPER LEFT. Its tip is the cursor hotspot around x=35%, y=35% of the canvas. The middle, ring and little fingers are naturally relaxed and softly curled toward the palm, grouped behind the index finger; thumb rests naturally beside them. The index silhouette must be unambiguous, comfortably relaxed rather than a stiff accusatory gesture. Empty hand, no object, no stamp, no pen. Entire extended index finger visible. Do not splay all fingers. Same wrist orientation and forearm direction as reference.
